95f74f840b445af8e4790d2e0218cad015db43bb.summary: A code-hosting repository index page titled as documentation of a CCC analysis of the FinSpy state trojan for Android. It lists folders, file names and commit messages only. The report itself is a PDF that is not included in the text, so no threat facts can be recorded.

95a9b62c3535d9bcf354344a050f2df6c1f5644a.summary: AhnLab ASEC reports that a backdoor previously spread as CHM files is now distributed as malicious LNK shortcut files, disguised as Excel documents that impersonate a Korean public organization. When run, the LNK starts PowerShell and mshta, sets persistence through a registry Run key, and polls a command server for commands that collect information and move files. The report links the activity to RedEyes (ScarCruft) and says the attacker keeps modifying its scripts.

9576cb014691594b4883416c6d08b77d3186e73f.summary: Juniper Threat Labs reports ongoing attacks, observed from August 2021, that exploit CVE-2021-35395 in firmware built with the Realtek Jungle SDK. The flaw is a command injection in a management interface. The payloads download shell scripts that install Mirai botnet malware, set up a cron job for persistence, and block reinfection.
